parse.title: Increased music appreciation
parse.wikitext:
<onlyinclude>
'''Increased music appreciation''' is defined as a general sense of an increased enjoyment of music. When music is listened to during this state, not only does it subjectively sound better, but the perceived music and lyrical content may have a profound impact on the listener.<ref name="KaelenBarrett2015">{{cite journal|last1=Kaelen|first1=M.|last2=Barrett|first2=F. S.|last3=Roseman|first3=L.|last4=Lorenz|first4=R.|last5=Family|first5=N.|last6=Bolstridge|first6=M.|last7=Curran|first7=H. V.|last8=Feilding|first8=A.|last9=Nutt|first9=D. J.|last10=Carhart-Harris|first10=R. L.|title=LSD enhances the emotional response to music|journal=Psychopharmacology|volume=232|issue=19|year=2015|pages=3607–3614|issn=0033-3158|doi=10.1007/s00213-015-4014-y}}</ref><ref name="KaelenRoseman2016">{{cite journal|last1=Kaelen|first1=Mendel|last2=Roseman|first2=Leor|last3=Kahan|first3=Joshua|last4=Santos-Ribeiro|first4=Andre|last5=Orban|first5=Csaba|last6=Lorenz|first6=Romy|last7=Barrett|first7=Frederick S.|last8=Bolstridge|first8=Mark|last9=Williams|first9=Tim|last10=Williams|first10=Luke|last11=Wall|first11=Matthew B.|last12=Feilding|first12=Amanda|last13=Muthukumaraswamy|first13=Suresh|last14=Nutt|first14=David J.|last15=Carhart-Harris|first15=Robin|title=LSD modulates music-induced imagery via changes in parahippocampal connectivity|journal=European Neuropsychopharmacology|volume=26|issue=7|year=2016|pages=1099–1109|issn=0924977X|doi=10.1016/j.euroneuro.2016.03.018}}</ref><ref name="Fachner2002">{{cite journal | vauthors=((Fachner, J.)) | journal=Looking Back, Looking Ahead-Popular Music Studies | title=The space between the notes-Research on cannabis and music perception. | issue=20 | pages=308–319 | date= 2002 | url=http://citeseerx.ist.psu.edu/viewdoc/download?doi=10.1.1.467.6346&rep=rep1&type=pdf}}</ref><ref name="Nichols2016">{{cite journal|last1=Nichols|first1=D. E.|title=Psychedelics|journal=Pharmacological Reviews|volume=68|issue=2|year=2016|pages=264–355|issn=1521-0081|doi=10.1124/pr.115.011478}}</ref><ref name="KaelenGiribaldi2018">{{cite journal|last1=Kaelen|first1=Mendel|last2=Giribaldi|first2=Bruna|last3=Raine|first3=Jordan|last4=Evans|first4=Lisa|last5=Timmerman|first5=Christopher|last6=Rodriguez|first6=Natalie|last7=Roseman|first7=Leor|last8=Feilding|first8=Amanda|last9=Nutt|first9=David|last10=Carhart-Harris|first10=Robin|title=The hidden therapist: evidence for a central role of music in psychedelic therapy|journal=Psychopharmacology|volume=235|issue=2|year=2018|pages=505–519|issn=0033-3158|doi=10.1007/s00213-017-4820-5}}</ref><ref name="BelserAgin-Liebes2017">{{cite journal|last1=Belser|first1=Alexander B.|last2=Agin-Liebes|first2=Gabrielle|last3=Swift|first3=T. Cody|last4=Terrana|first4=Sara|last5=Devenot|first5=Neşe|last6=Friedman|first6=Harris L.|last7=Guss|first7=Jeffrey|last8=Bossis|first8=Anthony|last9=Ross|first9=Stephen|title=Patient Experiences of Psilocybin-Assisted Psychotherapy: An Interpretative Phenomenological Analysis|journal=Journal of Humanistic Psychology|volume=57|issue=4|year=2017|pages=354–388|issn=0022-1678|doi=10.1177/0022167817706884}}</ref>

This experience can give one a sense of hyper-awareness of every sound, lyric, melody, and complex layer of noise within a song in addition to an enhanced ability to individually comprehend their significance and interplay. The perceived emotional intent of the musician and the meaning of the music may also be felt in a greater level clarity than that which is attainable during everyday sober living.<ref name="Fachner2002" /> This effect can result in the belief, legitimate or delusional, that one has connected with the “true meaning” or “spirit” behind an artist’s song. During particularly enjoyable songs, this effect can result in feelings of overwhelming harmony<ref name="KaelenGiribaldi2018" /> and a general sense of appreciation that can leave the person with a deep sense of connection towards the artist they are listening to. 

Increased music appreciation is commonly mistaken as a purely [[Auditory effects|auditory effect]] but is more likely the result of several coinciding components such as [[novelty enhancement]], [[Personal meaning intensification|personal meaning intensification]], [[Emotion intensification|emotion intensification]], and [[Auditory acuity enhancement|auditory acuity enhancement]]. It is most commonly induced under the influence of [[dosage#common|moderate]] [[dosage|dosages]] of [[hallucinogen|hallucinogenic]] compounds, such as [[psychedelic|psychedelics]],<ref name="KaelenBarrett2015" /><ref name="Nichols2016" /><ref name="McGlothlin1967">{{cite journal|last1=McGlothlin|first1=William|title=Long Lasting Effects of LSD on Normals|journal=Archives of General Psychiatry|volume=17|issue=5|year=1967|pages=521|issn=0003-990X|doi=10.1001/archpsyc.1967.01730290009002}}</ref> [[dissociative|dissociatives]],<ref>{{cite journal | vauthors=((Lim, D. K.)) | journal=Singapore Medical Journal | title=Ketamine associated psychedelic effects and dependence | volume=44 | issue=1 | pages=31–34 | date= January 2003 | issn=0037-5675}}</ref> and [[cannabinoid|cannabinoids]].<ref name="Fachner2002" /> However, it can also occur to a lesser extent under the influence of [[stimulants]]<ref name="Fachner2002" /><ref name="McGlothlin1967" /> and [[GABAergic]] [[depressant|depressants]].
</onlyinclude>
